sources.name: LMArena
sources.what: People compare two anonymous answers and vote for the better one.

sources.name: LiveBench
sources.what: New, hidden tasks every release, so models can't have seen the answers.

sources.name: Epoch AI
sources.what: Non-profit research group. Its Capabilities Index combines many benchmarks, with error bars.

sources.name: OpenRouter
sources.what: Developer prices per million tokens and the date each model became available.

sources.name: Official company pages
sources.credit: Each company's own news page or blog
sources.what: New model announcements from OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Google AI, Anthropic, Mistral, xAI, Meta and DeepSeek.

sources.name: Official pricing pages
sources.credit: Each company's pricing page or its own App Store listing
sources.what: Monthly plan prices for the apps, read every day from each company's own pricing page, or from the company's own Apple App Store listing (US prices) when its web page blocks servers.

sources.name: News feeds
sources.credit: AI lab blogs and tech news sites
sources.what: Headlines from OpenAI, Google, DeepMind, NVIDIA, Hugging Face, TechCrunch, The Verge, Ars Technica, MIT Tech Review and Wired.

bignews.rules: Only new model launches, big price changes, major product launches or shutdowns by AI labs, funding of about $1B or more, acquisitions of or by AI labs, and IPO filings.

rule: A model is called best only when all 3 independent sources put it in their top 3. Pictures have only 1 source, so no picture model is called best.
